data_card.source: Binance Spot BTCUSDT; audited saved OHLCV cohort
data_card.target: Population sigma7 of seven daily Close log returns; ddof=0; unannualized
data_card.window: 7 observed daily OHLCV bars through t-1
data_card.personal_data: none in these public market measurements
data_card.license_status: Source terms and final redistribution statement require review; no new data license is asserted
data_card.feature_dates: Each row is a target-date observation. Last OHLCV values belong to t-1, not the target day.
data_card.known_return6: last of the six observed log returns in the seven input closes
data_card.cohort_scope: E2 training/calibration/evaluation partitions; E3 fitted on the first 532 training examples and validated on 116

quality.scope: Saved audited windows and dates; source hash and schema checks do not close every leakage control

model_card.architecture: Causal CNN -> unidirectional LSTM -> temporal content attention -> positive additive output
model_card.use: Academic exploration of historical one-day volatility forecasts
limitations: Known historical calendar and unequal training policies
Novelty, academic defense and complete R3 remain unaccredited
Additional datasets, robust ablations and causal explanation remain incomplete
model_card.AI_assistance: Declared in code and report; not a human academic endorsement

statistical_scope: Retrospective 48-contrast Holm family; auxiliary MCS90 on another loss; not R3 certification
curve_scope: Representative seed 271801 fixed by ID; catalogue averages ten individual predictors per neural model
